title: Shopify Copilot Tax Matching Agent: matching engine and data model (stack 2/3)
summary: Shopify Copilot Tax Matching Agent adds a headless matching engine that uses AI to match Shopify tax lines to Business Central tax jurisdictions, creates tax areas, and includes comprehensive unit tests.
key_points: Registers a Copilot capability and calls GPT-4.1 to match Shopify tax-line titles to Business Central Tax Jurisdictions
Builds or reuses a Tax Area and seeds Tax Details
Tracks provenance (Created by Agent, Verified) and handles low-confidence matches deterministically
Configurable review-mode gate can hold Sales Document creation
Adds a test app with AITest suites, unit tests and accuracy datasets; the review UI ships in part 3
